before.body: B"H · MAIN MENU Choose Your Gate Adventure is the main climb now: one platform stage after another. Quick VS is still instant combat. MAIN PATH Open World Walk persistent 2D cities, overlap doors, enter interiors, serve shlichus, trade provisions, and train hands and feet. Walk into the city OPTION Expedition Atlas Thirty authored roads, citizens, crafting, weather, guardians, gear, quests, and optional profile sync. Inspect the world OPTION Online Co-op Two to four travelers share a server-authoritative enemy wave and three-phase guardian. Gather online OPTION Classic Adventure Run the original sixty-gate campaign as a direct linear climb. Climb the gates OPTION Quick VS Pure arena rules: Duel, Team Clash, Iron Covenant, Relic Storm, or custom contest. Gather fighters OPTION Settings Sound, bot count, restart, debug, and saved progress. Tune it OPTION Credits The vessel speaks about the force behind the clash. Read Change Fighter Tip: hold punch or kick, aim with the stick, release into the launch. 👊 PUNCH 🦵 KICK ↟ JUMP ↵ ENTER 🤝 GRAB 🛡️ GUARD ✨ SPECIAL / RECOVER
